question: Who among the following was appointed as the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of India Post Payments Bank in October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**J Venkatramu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• For a **three-year term**, the Center named **J Venkatramu** as the next **managing director (MD) and chief executive officer (CEO)** of** India Post Payments Bank.**
 
• He succeeded **Suresh Sethi.**
 
• **Venkatramu** has more than** 20 years of experience** working in the **banking industry**, namely in the** areas of payments, mobile banking, retail banking products, and project management** for digital financial services.
 
• He had previously been named the** chief digital officer of Equitas Small Finance Bank.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Seema Gupta:**

 
 
• Shri Apurva Chandra, IAS is **Secretary in the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting. **
 
 
 
• **S Aparna:**
 
 
• She was appointed to the **post of Executive Director,** **World Bank in 2017,** representing the** Constituency of India, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.**
